description: This file contains the implementation of 'git bisect', including commands for starting, resetting, running bisect operations, managing bisect terms, and replaying bisect logs. It defines key functions, command handlers, and internal logic for performing automated binary search to identify problematic commits in a Git repository.

methods.name: void free_terms(struct bisect_terms * terms)
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for the bisect_terms structure's 'term_good' and 'term_bad' strings.

methods.name: void set_terms(struct bisect_terms * terms,const char * bad,const char * good)
methods.description: Sets the 'term_good' and 'term_bad' strings in a bisect_terms structure.

methods.name: int write_terms(const char * bad,const char * good)
methods.description: Writes the specified 'bad' and 'good' terms to the bisect terms file.

methods.name: int bisect_reset(const char * commit)
methods.description: Resets the bisect state, optionally checking out a specified commit.

methods.name: void log_commit(FILE * fp,const char * fmt,const char * state,struct commit * commit)
methods.description: Logs information about a commit to a file in a formatted way.

methods.name: int bisect_write(const char * state,const char * rev,const struct bisect_terms * terms,int nolog)
methods.description: Records a bad or good revision in the bisect log and updates references accordingly.

methods.name: int check_and_set_terms(struct bisect_terms * terms,const char * cmd)
methods.description: Verifies and sets bisect terms based on commands or current file state.

methods.name: int inc_nr(const struct reference * ref UNUSED,void * cb_data)
methods.description: Increments a counter; used when iterating over references.

methods.name: void bisect_status(struct bisect_state * state,const struct bisect_terms * terms)
methods.description: Checks the current bisect state, counting known bad and good commits.

methods.name: void bisect_log_printf(const char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Prints formatted messages to stdout and appends them to the bisect log.

methods.name: void bisect_print_status(const struct bisect_terms * terms)
methods.description: Prints the current bisect status based on known bad/good counts.

methods.name: int bisect_next_check(const struct bisect_terms * terms,const char * current_term)
methods.description: Decides whether to proceed with the next bisect step based on current status.

methods.name: int get_terms(struct bisect_terms * terms)
methods.description: Reads the current bisect terms ('good' and 'bad') from the terms file.

methods.name: int bisect_terms(struct bisect_terms * terms,const char * option)
methods.description: Handles the 'terms' command; displays or sets bisect terms.

methods.name: int bisect_append_log_quoted(const char ** argv)
methods.description: Appends the command line arguments to the bisect log with quoting.

methods.name: int add_bisect_ref(const struct reference * ref,void * cb)
methods.description: Adds a reference's object ID to the list of revisions for bisecting.

methods.name: int prepare_revs(struct bisect_terms * terms,struct rev_info * revs)
methods.description: Prepares revision information for bisecting based on known bad/good terms.

methods.name: int bisect_skipped_commits(struct bisect_terms * terms)
methods.description: Logs commits that are skipped during bisect.

methods.name: int bisect_successful(struct bisect_terms * terms)
methods.description: Marks the first bad commit as the successful end of bisect and logs it.

methods.name: enum:bisect_error bisect_next(struct bisect_terms * terms,const char * prefix)
methods.description: Performs the next step in bisecting, including autostart if needed.

methods.name: enum:bisect_error bisect_auto_next(struct bisect_terms * terms,const char * prefix)
methods.description: Automatically proceeds to next bisect revision unless stopping conditions are met.

methods.name: enum:bisect_error bisect_start(struct bisect_terms * terms,int argc,const char ** argv)
methods.description: Starts a new bisect session, initializing refs, writing state, and processing parameters.

methods.name: int file_is_not_empty(const char * path)
methods.description: Checks if a file exists and is not empty.

methods.name: int bisect_autostart(struct bisect_terms * terms)
methods.description: Automatically initiates a bisect start if none is active.

methods.name: enum:bisect_error bisect_state(struct bisect_terms * terms,int argc,const char ** argv)
methods.description: Handles the 'bisect state' command; applies or retrieves bisect state info.

methods.name: enum:bisect_error bisect_log(void)
methods.description: Outputs the bisect log contents.

methods.name: int process_replay_line(struct bisect_terms * terms,struct strbuf * line)
methods.description: Processes a line from a bisect replay file, executing contained commands.

methods.name: enum:bisect_error bisect_replay(struct bisect_terms * terms,const char * filename)
methods.description: Replays a bisect log file, restoring bisect state step-by-step.

methods.name: enum:bisect_error bisect_skip(struct bisect_terms * terms,int argc,const char ** argv)
methods.description: Skips specified revisions during bisect.

methods.name: int bisect_visualize(struct bisect_terms * terms,int argc,const char ** argv)
methods.description: Visualizes current bisect state using logs or GUI tools.

methods.name: int get_first_good(const struct reference * ref,void * cb_data)
methods.description: Retrieves the hash of the first good commit reference.

methods.name: int do_bisect_run(const char * command)
methods.description: Runs a shell command during bisect to test a revision.

methods.name: int verify_good(const struct bisect_terms * terms,const char * command)
methods.description: Verifies a candidate revision as a good revision in bisect.

methods.name: int bisect_run(struct bisect_terms * terms,int argc,const char ** argv)
methods.description: Repeatedly runs bisect testing commands until bisect completes or errors.

methods.name: int cmd_bisect__reset(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix UNUSED,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Command handler to reset bisect state, optionally to a specific commit.

methods.name: int cmd_bisect__terms(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix UNUSED,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Handles the 'terms' command, displaying or setting bisect terms.

methods.name: int cmd_bisect__start(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix UNUSED,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Starts a new bisect session based on arguments.

methods.name: int cmd_bisect__next(int argc,const char ** argv UNUSED,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Advances to the next bisect revision.

methods.name: int cmd_bisect__log(int argc UNUSED,const char ** argv UNUSED,const char * prefix UNUSED,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Outputs the bisect log.

methods.name: int cmd_bisect__replay(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix UNUSED,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Replays a bisect log file to restore state.

methods.name: int cmd_bisect__skip(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix UNUSED,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Skips revisions during bisect according to args.

methods.name: int cmd_bisect__visualize(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix UNUSED,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Visualizes bisect progress.

methods.name: int cmd_bisect__run(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix UNUSED,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Runs a command repeatedly in bisect mode, automating testing.

methods.name: int cmd_bisect(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo)
methods.description: Main command dispatch function handling subcommands related to 'git bisect'.
